answer: Each node locks a copper stake S and suffers quadratic slashing f(x)=alpha*x^2, so collateral erodes with the square of any misbehavior weight. A Sybil cluster of n identities then faces marginal cost C(n)=beta*n^2 > V because the zephyr delay from a zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces honest finality before any coordinated fork. The game thus yields negative expected attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium where rational agents forge consensus rather than risk unbounded loss.
